items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 17 at 12:56PM PST until November 18 at 10:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 9 to 14 ft at 15 seconds and southeast winds 15 to
25 kt.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR out 10 NM.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM PST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
